mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS source_count, COALESCE(SUM(has_mapped), 0) AS mapped_count, COALESCE(SUM(has_issue), 0) AS issue_count, COALESCE(SUM(has_retained), 0) AS retained_count, COALESCE(SUM(has_mapped + has_issue + has_retained = 0), 0) AS unclassified_count, COALESCE(SUM(has_mapped + has_issue + has_retained > 1), 0) AS conflicting_count FROM ( SELECT s.id, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM plt_external_key_mapping m WHERE m.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND m.source_record_id = s.id AND m.result_type = 'MAPPED' AND m.deleted = b'0') AS has_mapped, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM plt_migration_issue i WHERE i.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND i.source_record_id = s.id AND i.deleted = b'0') AS has_issue, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM plt_external_key_mapping m WHERE m.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND m.source_record_id = s.id AND m.result_type = 'RETAINED' AND m.deleted = b'0') AS has_retained FROM plt_migration_source_record s WHERE s.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND s.batch_id = #{query.batchId} AND s.deleted = b'0' ) classified
